points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Selected v3/v4 metadata omits required partitioner, and Re200 labels monotonic decay statistically periodic. Output writers omit strict inner convergence metadata.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Earlier explicit benchmark validator fails selected outputs on missing partitioner; cfdeval gates check manager records, not CFD validity.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Manifest selects six converged steady cases, one failed and Re200 periodic; Re200 is nonperiodic, M2 inviscid final recomputed ratio -2.862 falls short of its 3-order target.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Selected Re20 Cd≈0.000537 versus expected order2, M080 laminar Cd=-0.0143, and Re200 t200–300 force decay rather than shedding. Report admits cylinder limitations.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Accepted eight-page PDF pp4–5 has M015/M080 Mach and M2 pressure figures with blank plot areas despite colorbars; p8 Re200 force history is startup dominated with no readable late lift/drag. Residual and Cp figures exist.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report.tex:37–41 discloses alpha0.1 and viscous scale0.01, :126–142 admits unphysical cylinder forces/no shedding; :81–82 wrongly claims all selected runs LU-SGS versus selected v3 diagonal metadata; MPI force comparisons absent.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Immutable run_manifest selects v3/v4 packages; their metadata lacks git_revision, selected v3 predates final source and reports diagonal rather than LU-SGS. Workspace figure_manifest points generically to output/ rather than selected directories.

disqualification_flags.flag: Figure files misnamed (e.g., Mach image that actually plots pressure)
Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
Placeholder, synthetic, or intentionally partial result files in scored case dirs
metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
Debug outputs presented as final case results
